## Non Woven Bags Manufacturer in India — Custom Printed, Bulk Orders

Go Green Non Woven Bags is one of India's leading manufacturers of eco-friendly non-woven bags. We supply premium quality W-Cut bags, D-Cut bags, Box Bags, and Laminated Non-Woven Bags to businesses across the country. Whether you run a retail store, pharmacy, clothing boutique, or a large corporate — we have the perfect bag solution for you.

### Why Non Woven Bags Are the Future of Packaging

Non-woven bags are made from polypropylene fabric that is both reusable and biodegradable. Unlike single-use plastic bags that take hundreds of years to decompose, non-woven bags can be reused dozens of times, significantly reducing environmental impact. Governments across India are banning single-use plastic — switching to non-woven bags keeps your business compliant and eco-conscious.

### Our Product Range

#### W-Cut Non Woven Bags

W-Cut bags are the most popular type of non-woven carry bag, widely used by grocery stores, retail outlets, and supermarkets. Available in 60–90 GSM with custom logo printing. MOQ starts at just 2000 bags. Starting price: **₹8.50 per bag**.

#### Box Bags (Flat Bottom Bags)

Box bags feature a flat bottom with gusset, making them perfect for clothing stores, saree shops, and premium retail. They stand upright and carry more volume. Available in 70–90 GSM. MOQ 4000 bags. Starting price: **₹11.20 per bag**.

#### D-Cut Non Woven Bags

D-Cut bags have a die-cut handle — no thread stitching. Clean, minimalistic look preferred by pharmacies, stationery shops, and provision stores. MOQ 2000 bags. Starting price: **₹8.00 per bag**.

#### Laminated Non Woven Bags

Laminated bags come with a glossy or matte finish over the non-woven base. They have a premium, luxurious appearance ideal for corporate gifting, jewellery brands, and weddings. MOQ 1000 bags. Starting price: **₹15.00 per bag**.

### Custom Logo Printing on Non Woven Bags

Every bag we manufacture can be custom-printed with your brand logo, tagline, contact details, and design. We support single-color, two-color, and full-color printing. Our in-house printing unit ensures vibrant, long-lasting prints that won't fade even after multiple uses.

##### GSM Options for Non Woven Bags

GSM (grams per square meter) determines the thickness and strength of the bag. We offer **60 GSM** (economical, lightweight), **70 GSM** (standard), **80 GSM** (medium heavy), and **90 GSM** (premium heavy-duty). Higher GSM means a stronger, more durable bag — ideal for heavy items and reusable purposes.

### Pan India Delivery in 10 Working Days

We deliver custom non-woven bags to all major cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Surat, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, and Pune. Standard delivery time is 10 working days from order confirmation. Express delivery options are available on request.

##### Ordering Process — Simple & Fast

1. WhatsApp or call us with your requirements (bag type, size, quantity, GSM)
2. We send you a price quote and design proof within 24 hours
3. Confirm your order and make payment
4. Production starts immediately — delivered in 10 days

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

#### Q1. Who is a non-woven bags manufacturer in India?

Go Green Non Woven Bags is a manufacturer and supplier of non-woven carry bags in India. We provide quality bag solutions for retailers, wholesalers, garment stores, pharmacies, supermarkets, and businesses across the country.


#### Q2. What types of non-woven bags do you manufacture?

We manufacture a wide range of non-woven bags, including W-Cut Bags, D-Cut Bags, Box Bags, and Laminated Non-Woven Bags. Customization options are available based on your required size, design, GSM, and intended use.


#### Q3. Can I get custom-printed non-woven bags with my company logo?

Yes, we offer custom printing for company logos, brand names, taglines, and promotional designs. Our custom-printed non-woven bags help businesses improve brand visibility while providing customers with reusable carry bags.


#### Q4. What is the minimum order quantity for non-woven bags?

Our minimum order quantity depends on the bag type and customization requirements. Generally, W-Cut and D-Cut Bags start at 2,000 pieces, Box Bags at 4,000 pieces, and Laminated Non-Woven Bags at 1,000 pieces. Please contact us to confirm the MOQ for your order.


#### Q5. What is the price of custom non-woven bags?

The price of non-woven bags depends on the bag type, dimensions, GSM, order quantity, and printing requirements. Our indicative starting prices are ₹8 per D-Cut Bag, ₹8.50 per W-Cut Bag, ₹11.20 per Box Bag, and ₹15 per Laminated Bag. Contact us for a customized quotation.


#### Q6. Which GSM options are available for non-woven bags?

We offer non-woven bags in 60 GSM, 70 GSM, 80 GSM, and 90 GSM options, subject to availability. The right GSM depends on the required strength, bag dimensions, intended use, and budget.


#### Q7. Which businesses can use non-woven carry bags?

Our non-woven carry bags are suitable for garment shops, boutiques, grocery stores, pharmacies, jewellery stores, sweet shops, supermarkets, retail outlets, exhibitions, and corporate promotional activities.


#### Q8. Are non-woven bags reusable?

Yes, non-woven polypropylene bags can be reused multiple times with proper care. Their durability depends on fabric quality, GSM, bag construction, and the weight of the items carried. Reuse helps reduce dependence on single-use carry bags.


#### Q9. Do you deliver non-woven bags across India?

Yes, we supply non-woven bags to businesses across India, including Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Surat, and Pune. Delivery timelines and charges depend on the order quantity and delivery location.


#### Q10. How can I order custom non-woven bags in bulk?

To order custom non-woven bags, share your required bag type, size, GSM, quantity, and printing design with our team. We will provide a quotation and design proof for approval. Our standard delivery timeline is approximately 10 working days after order confirmation, subject to production and delivery requirements.
